semantics.summary: Disables GURU checking when the argument is 0 and enables it when the argument is nonzero. On a GURU Meditation, control transfers to ONERROR GOSUB or error #109 is generated.
side-effects: May transfer control to ONERROR GOSUB or raise error #109 on a GURU Meditation.

printed-pages: Chapter 13, printed p. 13-36 (same feature: combined update scan pp. 14-6–14-7)
notes: The 3.5 addendum distinguishes the GURU command from the GURU function. Error messages #110–#118 correspond to normal GURUs $2–$A.
In compiled 3.5 programs, RESUME NEXT and RESUME LABEL cannot be executed after an ONERROR GOSUB call caused by a GURU; this restriction is recorded in the source inventory.

support.pending-reason: No Amiga GURU/error handling implementation or executable reference-interpreter conformance tests are registered.
